title: Launchpad microflow: model carousel + inline request snippets for getting-started
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact set of annotated screenshots and export assets for the Hosted API getting-started flow focused on a model selection carousel and the inline request builder (code snippets for JS/Python/cURL). Provide both light and dark mode variants, mobile-adapted slices, and accessible alt-text. Deliverables will be used across docs (Getting Started), SDK quickstarts, and the in-product first-run surface.
deliverables: 3 hero images (desktop) - model carousel, request builder, code split
3 mobile slices (iPhone/Android) - simplified carousel + inline code toggle
Annotated specs (Figma frames with overlay callouts)
Copy-ready snippets: JS, Python, cURL (short, under 4 lines for quickstart)
Filename and export manifest (naming, size, alt text)
acceptance_criteria: All hero images exported in PNG@2x and SVG and uploaded to Drive
Each screenshot includes 1-2 short annotations (CTA, model badge, latency badge)
Code snippets render with correct syntax highlighting and copy button area
Dark mode variants visually validated against console theme
Mobile slices fit within 360x780 artboards and maintain legibility
Assets referenced in docs PR and visible in review link
tasks: Audit existing getting-started screenshots and list differences
Design updated model carousel with compact badges for 4 model classes
Create request builder state showing: prompt, max_tokens, model pick
Produce concise JS/Python/cURL snippets and test copy/paste
Export light/dark/mobile assets and upload manifest
Handoff to docs with Figma frames and alt text
review_feedback: 2025-10-06 - Liam Chen (PM): prefer shorter code samples (2 lines) for hero tiles; reduce visual noise on carousel badges
2025-10-07 - Tyler Brooks (Engineering): requested that model badges include rough cost tier labels (low/medium/high) and fallback variant info
2025-10-08 - Priya Iyer (Developer Advocate): flagged that cURL example requires header example for API key usage to avoid confusion
decisions: Keep carousel to max 4 visible cards with a horizontal scroll for extras
Include small cost-tier pill and latency microcopy under model name
Provide both full and trimmed code snippets: hero (2 lines) + expandable 6-line example in docs
Use system font stack for export assets to minimize rendering differences in docs

2025-10-04 - Marina Gomez: I’ll start frames for desktop and mobile; will iterate after PM review.
2025-10-06 - Marina Gomez: Uploaded first pass exports to Drive, added alt text stubs for reviewer edits.

next_steps: Finalize dark-mode color corrections, implement cost-tier microcopy and hand off finalized assets to docs PR (github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/780) for inclusion in getting-started page.
notes: Aim for assets that read clearly when embedded in a docs two-column layout. Prioritize low cognitive load: single focal CTA per image, minimal code lines in hero tiles, and consistent badge placement so screenshots can be parsed programmatically by the docs engine for alt text generation.
